snippet.title: Fungidemi | Gameplay Trailer | Wishlist now on Steam
snippet.description:
Fungidemi is an incremental RPG game where you gather your party, sharpen your skills, find magical weapons and explore unique maps while fulfilling small quests in a heart-warming story.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4848370/Fungidemi?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=pre_release
